---
title: "climt"
---

**climt** (Climate Modelling and Diagnostics Toolkit) is an open-source Python
framework for building and running climate models. It provides modular,
composable components — radiation, convection, surface, dynamics — with a
consistent interface so they can be mixed, matched, and extended.

## What's here

- **Experiments** — long-form research case studies: reproducible investigations
  with full methodology, dead-ends and all.
- **User Guide** — *(coming soon)* component reference, configuration, and
  worked examples.
- **Radiative Transfer Walkthrough** — *(coming soon)* a graduate-level tour of
  non-grey radiation, correlated-k, and the picket-fence scheme.
- **API Reference** — *(coming soon)* auto-generated from docstrings.
